comments.body:
They are a real company & actually rent rooms. BUT: They manipulate their google reviews imo. Very bad communication, lying to tenants, they really only care about gettiing somebody to rent their rooms. They do not care if they make you live with creepy people, they do not care about fulfilling any initially promised agreement ( the contract is completely unreliable), they price the apartments way higher than if you would rent one directly from the the Agencies. I had to pressure them into letting me see the apartment before moving in. If you only care about having a place to sleep it might be alright but if you would like to have a pleasant co-living situation, it is definitely not the right company. I also noticed that almost the whole worker crew changed over the last year. One year ago it still used to be easier to communicate with them, now it is basically impossible.

If you are a group of 2/3 people I really recommend you to just rent a whole apartment ( not from them) and share the rent. Cheaper, easier, less headaches.
comments.author: GlobalTumbleweed8872
